span.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-size: 14px; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400;

b.span: Physical GPR SRAM Banks (1R1W per Bank; SIMT Width = 1024 bits)

div.span: If rs1, rs2, rs3 hit different Banks, they fetch concurrently.
If they hit the SAME Bank (e.g. rs1=r1, rs2=r5 -> both hit Bank 1),
XBAR generates Stall (has_collision=1) and reads over multiple cycles.
